test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the following pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The following pie chart shows the breakup of sales of the different products of Company X in the year 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee81a399f949a5903c3219679d31e35c0bf6a095eccbdae15b987f0eb9bb7e5f.png] 

If the total number of items sold by the company was 1000 in 2022, what was the total number of raincoats and jackets sold by the company in the year?
solution:
**Given:**

Total items sold = 1000

Percentage of Raincoats = 13%

Percentage of Jackets = 8%

**Formula used:**

Number of items sold = dfrac{{Percentage}}{100} times {Total number of items}

**Calculation:**

Number of Raincoats sold = dfrac{13}{100} times 1000 = 130

Number of Jackets sold = dfrac{8}{100} times 1000 = 80

Total number of Raincoats and Jackets sold = 130 + 80 = 210

**∴ The total number of raincoats and jackets sold by the company is 210.**
